targetAudience: Engineers, technical founders, and editors evaluating architecture or research trade-offs

stanceAndPerspective.uncertaintyPolicy: State exact sample size, test boundary, or missing verification explicitly instead of using vague hedging.
stanceAndPerspective.evidenceRequirement: Every comparative claim must pair with a measurable metric, named source + year, or reproducible boundary condition.
rhetoricalGuards: Start with the conclusion, failure mode, or concrete measurement rather than macro-era framing.
Prefer concrete nouns and active verbs over abstract nominalizations.
Do not invent dramatic contrast pivots ('Not X, but Y') when a direct factual statement suffices.
End on the concrete trade-off or next verification step rather than a moralizing summary.

positiveSkeletons.name: Conclusion + Evidence Ledger
sequence: Measured numbers, sample size, or failure mode
Concrete next action with exit gate

positiveSkeletons.name: Observation -> Flawed Intuition -> Mechanism
sequence: Why the intuitive fix fails in practice

positiveExemplars.text: 本次压测覆盖 14 个支付网关，p95 结算耗时为 180 ms，高于 150 ms 目标值。瓶颈集中在跨区证书校验（占单次耗时 41%），仅扩容下游数据库连接池无法缓解；下周先在华东节点启用本地 OCSP 缓存，再复测 72 小时。
structuralNotes: 首句直接给样本口径、实测值与目标差距
第二句指出根因占比并否定无效方案，不含空洞修饰
尾句落到具体动作与复测窗口，无升华口号

positiveExemplars.text: Banning twenty overused adjectives rarely fixes flat prose. When a model loses its top lexical shortcuts, it shifts to structural shortcuts—three-word slogan chains and binary contrast pivots—because post-training still rewards familiar cadence. Breaking the loop requires locking factual spans first, then sampling across distinct paragraph skeletons.
structuralNotes: Alternates a crisp 9-word opening claim with a 30-word causal explanation and a 19-word operational takeaway (high burstiness)
Names the concrete displacement mechanism instead of using hype adjectives

forbidCaricaturePatterns: Forced slang or intentional typos to fake human warmth
Chained one-line aphorisms pretending to be punchy
Repeating the same opening rhetorical frame across consecutive documents
